disposition_reason: Tables 1 and 2 print triplicate cadmium and iron results with averages for 12 potato chip products from Libyan markets.

study.design: Market survey of 12 potato chip products, three replicates each
study.origin: not stated (authors suggest some are imported)
study.market: several markets in Elajelat and Sabratha, Libya
study.method: Dried at 70 °C, 0.5 g microwave-digested with HNO3/H2O2; flame and graphite-furnace AAS (Thermo GF95)
study.qa: Quantified against concurrent standards; ultrapure reagents; no CRM, recovery or blank results reported

findings.group: retail product 1 (Rio de Janeiro style flavor), Elajelat and Sabratha markets
findings.notes: Concentration in the digest solution (0.5 g dried chips digested and made up to 20 mL, later filtered into 50 mL flasks), reported as mg/l; per-litre value kept unconverted. Brand names summarised as retail products 1-12.

unresolved: Cd mean for product 3 (sour cream flavor) printed as 1.8300 mg/l is excluded: its replicates 0.7040, 0.6600 and 0.6300 average 0.665 and its printed SD 0.0372 fits the replicates, so the average is misprinted. The abstract and text range maximum (1.8300) rest on this value.
Results are mg/l of digest solution; the digest volume is given as both 20 mL and 50 mL flasks, so no mg/kg conversion is possible.
Lead is not measured despite the keyword list.
